title: CLR/99/2023 of KALYANI SADGURU Vs SATYA KUMAR RAO

paras.text:
2024:UHC:6590
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
10th SEPTEMBER, 2024
CIVIL REVISION NO.99 OF 2023
Kalyani Sadguru .....Revisionist
Versus
Satya Kumar Rao .....Respondent
Counsel for the Revisionist : Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik,
Advocate.
Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
In Original Suit No.68 of 2021, filed before the
Senior Civil Judge, Rishikesh, District Dehradun, the
revisionist - defendant was not present. Therefore, on
22.03.2023, the learned trial court directed the said suit to
proceed ex-parte against the revisionist - defendant. An
application to recall the said order dated 22.03.2023 was
filed by the revisionist - defendant. The said application has
been dismissed vide impugned order dated 30.05.2023.
2. Heard Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik, learned
counsel for the revisionist and Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned
counsel for the respondent.
3. Mr. Harsh Vardhan Dhanik, Advocate, on
instruction, has requested to grant three weeks' time from
today to the revisionist - defendant to file her written
statement in the said original suit.
4. Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate appearing for the
1

2024:UHC:6590
respondent, on instruction, agrees with the said request of
the revisionist, but on cost.
5. With the consent of learned counsel for both the
parties, the impugned order dated 30.05.2023 and order
dated 22.03.2023 are set aside on the cost of Rs.25,000/-
(Rupees twenty five thousand). The revisionist - defendant
is granted three weeks' time from today to file her written
statement. No further opportunity shall be granted to the
revisionist - defendant to file her written statement.
6. Civil Revision (No.99 of 2023) stands disposed of
accordingly.
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dt:10.09.2024
Pant/
